Poe’s work owes much to the concern of Romanticism C. shaping plausible fabrics out of impalpable materials D. his own feverish dreams, to which he applied a rare faculty of
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. with the occult and the satanic which in turn, owes much also to

B. Poe’s work owes much to the concern of Romanticism

C. shaping plausible fabrics out of impalpable materials

D. his own feverish dreams, to which he applied a rare faculty of
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: B, A, D, C

Key Points

  • Part B: This part introduces the main idea of the sentence, stating that Poe's work is influenced by the Romanticism movement.
  • Part A: This connects with the first part, explaining that Poe's work owes much to the occult and the satanic, and this influence can be traced back to Romanticism.
  • Part D: This provides additional information about how Poe's work was influenced – through his own feverish dreams and his unique ability to apply those dreams to his writing.
  • Part C: This concludes the sentence by describing how Poe applied his rare faculty – by shaping plausible fabrics out of impalpable materials. It adds a vivid description of Poe's creative process.
  • So, the correct sequence forms a coherent and logically flowing sentence about the influence of Romanticism, the occult, the satanic, Poe's dreams, and his unique creative process.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

questions.question: Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence. A. That the only true individual B. Is the holy man C. It has frequently been claimed D. Which the traditional society of India tolerates
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

A. That the only true individual

B. Is the holy man

C. It has frequently been claimed

D. Which the traditional society of India tolerates
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "C, A, D, B."

 Key Points

  • The correct order, C, A, D, B, makes a coherent grammatical and logical argument and narrative which states:
    • C. It has frequently been claimed: This sentence introduces the claim or thesis, so it serves as the leading statement or introduction. It informs the reader that an assertion is about to be discussed which has been made multiple times before.
    • A. That the only true individual: This phrase extends the claim mentioned in paragraph "C." It tells us the subject of this claim is a particular type of person categorized as the 'true individual,' but does not specify yet who this individual is.
    • D. Whom the traditional society of India tolerates: This part of the sentence is specifying who this 'true individual' is. It suggests that this individual is someone who is tolerated by traditional society in India. At this point, the reader knows the claim is about a particular type of individual who is acceptable in traditional Indian society.
    • B. Is the holy man: The final phrase, "Is the holy man," serves as the conclusion of the argument. It identifies and clarifies who this 'true individual' is. It finalizes the claim by stating that this 'true individual,' tolerated by traditional Indian society, is a holy man.
  • This ordering provides a complete, coherent thought and is chronologically correct because it starts by stating the claim, identifies the topic, gives a further attribute to this topic regarding its acceptance in traditional Indian society, and ends by identifying who exactly this 'true individual' is - a holy man.

Correct sentence: It has frequently been claimed (C) that the only true individual (A) which the traditional society of India tolerates (D) is the holy man (B) .

questions.question: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order. P. The average adult gets two to four colds a year, while the average child may get six to eight. Q. It is the most frequent infectious disease in humans. R. They occur more commonly during the winter. S. The common cold, also known simply as the cold, is a viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory tract that primarily affects the nose.
questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

P. The average adult gets two to four colds a year, while the average child may get six to eight.

Q. It is the most frequent infectious disease in humans.

R. They occur more commonly during the winter.

S. The common cold, also known simply as the cold, is a viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory tract that primarily affects the nose.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2'.

Key Points

  • The correct order for the sentences is indeed SQPR.
  • The first sentence (S) introduces the topic, which is the common cold.
  • The next sentence (Q) provides more information about the prevalence of this disease.
  • The third sentence (P) offers specific details about how often adults and children typically get colds.
  • Finally, the last sentence (R) provides additional information about the seasonal occurrence of colds.
  • This order creates a clear, logical progression of ideas about the common cold.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: 'The common cold, also known simply as the cold, is a viral infectious disease of the upper respiratory tract that primarily affects the nose (S). It is the most frequent infectious disease in humans (Q). The average adult gets two to four colds a year, while the average child may get six to eight (P). They occur more commonly during the winter (R).'

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the sentences in the correct sequence to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.
A) This past summer, my dream finally came true.
B) Strange lands, exciting places, and new cultures have always fascinated me.
C) Ever since I was a little girl, I dreamed about travelling overseas.
D) I got to travel to England, France, Switzerland, and Germany.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.
 
Key Points
  • The paragraph begins by introducing the fascination with travel and dreams from a young age.
  • Sentence C is the first sentence as it sets the context of the lifelong dream:
    • "Ever since I was a little girl, I dreamed about travelling overseas."
  • Sentence B follows as it elaborates on the fascination with travel:
    • "Strange lands, exciting places, and new cultures have always fascinated me."
  • Sentence A is the third sentence because it describes the realization of the dream:
    • "This past summer, my dream finally came true."
  • Sentence D is the fourth as it provides specifics about the travel experience:
    • "I got to travel to England, France, Switzerland, and Germany."

The correct sequence is CBAD.

questions.questionHtml:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P. In Tokyo, they built an expressway linking the international airport in Haneda to the centre and widened some of the city's major arteries.

Q. These infrastructure improvements helped to bring about the Japanese economic miracle over the next couple of decades.

R. Tokyo 2020 was supposed to be a great economic stimulus, replicating the achievements of Tokyo 1964.

S. It was thanks to hosting the Olympics that Japan invested in infrastructure such as the famous Shinkansen bullet train.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "RSPQ"

Key Points

  • Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
  • Statement R is the opening sentence of the passage which says that Tokyo 2020 was meant to be a massive economic boost, replicating Tokyo 1964's accomplishments.
  • Statement S is the second sentence of the passage which explains that Japan spent in infrastructure such as the renowned Shinkansen bullet train as a result of holding the Olympics.
  • Statement P is the third sentence of the passage which explains that in Tokyo, they constructed a motorway connecting Haneda International Airport to the city centre and expanded some of the city's main thoroughfares.
  • Statement Q is the last sentence of the passage which shows that these infrastructure upgrades contributed to Japan's economic success over the next few decades.

Hence, the correct sequence is R, S, P, Q

The correct answer is option 1.

The correct passage is: R. Tokyo 2020 was supposed to be a great economic stimulus, replicating the achievements of Tokyo 1964. S. It was thanks to hosting the Olympics that Japan invested in infrastructure such as the famous Shinkansen bullet train. P. In Tokyo, they built an expressway linking the international airport in Haneda to the centre and widened some of the city's major arteries. Q. These infrastructure improvements helped to bring about the Japanese economic miracle over the next couple of decades.

B) first name is Adam

C) that no one even

D) he is so rude

questions.solution:
Key Points

  • The correct order of the sentence parts starts with "D) he is so rude" as it introduces the subject of the sentence.
  • Following "D", "A) to his neighbours" logically continues the sentence, indicating to whom the subject's rudeness is directed.
  • Next, "C) that no one even" adds further information about the extent of the subject's rudeness.
  • The sequence is logically continued with "E) knows that his", which connects the preceding information to the final detail about the subject.
  • Finally, "B) first name is Adam" completes the sentence, revealing the specific detail that was unknown due to the subject's rudeness.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: "He is so rude to his neighbours that no one even knows that his first name is Adam."

  • Option 3 ("A, C, B, D, E") creates a disjointed sentence that does not logically flow or make coherent sense.
  • Option 4 ("C, E, B, A, D") also fails to create a coherent sentence, starting in the middle of the thought process rather than introducing the subject and his behavior.

B.The taxi stopped.
C.Mr. Satterthwaite flung himself out and raced up the stone stairs to the second floor like a young athlete.
D.He pushed it open, and the great voice welcomed him.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e. BCAD
Key Points
  • The paragraph begins with "The taxi stopped," which is correctly indicated by part (B).
  • Following this, "Mr. Satterthwaite flung himself out and raced up the stone stairs to the second floor like a young athlete" (C) continues the logical sequence, describing the actions following the stopping of the taxi.
  • The next part, "The door of the flat was ajar," (A) provides a visual detail that Mr. Satterthwaite encounters as he reaches the flat.
  • Ending with, "He pushed it open, and the great voice welcomed him" (D) completes the process of entering the flat and being greeted.
Therefore, the correct answer is BCAD.
Additional Information
  • Option 1 (BACD): This option starts with the door being ajar before the taxi stops, which is logically inconsistent.
  • Option 2 (ABCD): This option starts with the door being ajar, which disrupts the narrative flow by placing a later detail first.
  • Option 4 (DCBA): This option starts with the voice welcoming, then goes backwards, which misarranges the sequence of actions.

questions.question: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. It superseded India's previous educational strategy, which was created in 1986. B. The Indian union cabinet approved the country's national education strategy on 29 July 2020. C. And it provides a framework for education from the primary grades up to higher education, as well as for vocational training in both urban and rural settings. D. This policy significantly improves India's educational system. Restructuring India's educational system is the primary goal of the National Education Policy 2022.
questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It superseded India's previous educational strategy, which was created in 1986.

B. The Indian union cabinet approved the country's national education strategy on 29 July 2020.

C. And it provides a framework for education from the primary grades up to higher education, as well as for vocational training in both urban and rural settings.

D. This policy significantly improves India's educational system. Restructuring India's educational system is the primary goal of the National Education Policy 2022.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BADC'.

Key Points

  • The logical sequence of the given question is as follows:
    • B. The Indian union cabinet approved the country's national education strategy on 29 July 2020.
      • This line introduces the inception of the national education strategy in India, signifying an important event where the strategy was officially sanctioned.
    • A. It superseded India's previous educational strategy, which was created in 1986.
      • Here, it's explained that the newly approved strategy replaced the old one from 1986, indicating a shift or upgrade in the educational approach taken by the country.
    • D. This policy significantly improves India's educational system. Restructuring India's educational system is the primary goal of the National Education Policy 2022.
      • This line elaborates on the impact and goal of the new strategy, emphasizing its purpose of reforming and enhancing the educational system in India.
    • C. And it provides a framework for education from the primary grades up to higher education, as well as for vocational training in both urban and rural settings.
      • Lastly, this sentence outlines the comprehensive nature of the strategy, indicating that it covers education from primary levels through higher education, along with vocational training in diverse settings, thus completing the contextual picture of the national education strategy.
  • Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.
     

Correct Sequence: The Indian union cabinet approved the country's national education strategy on 29 July 2020.  It superseded India's previous educational strategy, which was created in 1986. This policy significantly improves India's educational system. Restructuring India's educational system is the primary goal of the National Education Policy 2022.  And it provides a framework for education from the primary grades up to higher education, as well as for vocational training in both urban and rural settings.

Important Points

  • Practice is key! Regularly practicing rearranging sentences or paragraphs will improve your ability to discern logical sequences and enhance your overall comprehension skills.
  • When facing questions that require rearranging sentences or paragraphs to form a coherent sequence, consider the following steps:
    • Read Carefully: Go through each sentence attentively to understand its context, topic, and the information it provides. Note any connecting phrases or words that link sentences together.
    • Identify the Logical Flow: Look for clues within the sentences that indicate a sequence. Sentences might introduce a topic, provide details, give examples, or conclude the idea. Pay attention to time markers, cause-and-effect relationships, or other transitional phrases.
    • Start with Key Points: Sometimes, certain sentences act as introductory or concluding statements. Begin with sentences that introduce the topic or provide a conclusion, as they often set the context or summarize the content.
    • Connect Related Ideas: Identify relationships between sentences. For example, a sentence might explain or support the idea presented in the previous sentence. Look for coherence and progression in the ideas presented.
    • Consider Keyword Consistency: Check for keywords or recurring themes that link sentences. These can help establish a logical sequence. Pay attention to pronouns (he, it, they) referring to previously mentioned subjects.
    • Evaluate Options: Once you have a tentative sequence, review it to ensure that the ideas flow logically and coherently. Eliminate options that disrupt the logical flow or create inconsistencies.
    • Test the Flow: Mentally or visually run through the proposed sequence to verify if it reads smoothly and makes sense. Ensure that there's a clear progression from the beginning to the end.
    • Double-Check: Before finalizing your answer, double-check the sequence to confirm that it presents a cohesive and logical progression of ideas.

questions.question: Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph. A. The test procedure starts at 10 a.m. in all the test centres. B. When you enter the test hall, you should have your Test Admit Card with you. C. You are, therefore, required to reach the test centre by 9.30 a.m. D. Remember that, if you report after 10 a.m., you will not be admitted.
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The test procedure starts at 10 a.m. in all the test centres.

B. When you enter the test hall, you should have your Test Admit Card with you.

C. You are, therefore, required to reach the test centre by 9.30 a.m.

D. Remember that, if you report after 10 a.m., you will not be admitted.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'ACDB.'

Key Points

  • While arranging the parts of the passage given in options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them, so let’s find out.  
    • The opener will be A as it introduces the context of the paragraph.
    • After this, C will come as it is talking about the timing to reach the test centre.
    • After this, D will come as it is talking about the effects of not reaching the test centre before 10 a.m.
    • B follows D as B talks about the admit card.
    • The last sentence will be B as it is providing a conclusion to the context.
  • ​​The correct sequence:​

A. The test procedure starts at 10 a.m. in all the test centres.

C. You are, therefore, required to reach the test centre by 9.30 a.m.

D. Remember that, if you report after 10 a.m., you will not be admitted.

B. When you enter the test hall, you should have your Test Admit Card with you.

Additional Information    
 

  • Steps for solving Para Jumbles:
    • Clues include pronouns, like he, she, it, this, that, these, those; adverbs like formally, really; article a, an and the; definers like actually, finally, another; connectors like but, yet, both, also and neither nor, or, however, nevertheless.
    • Now, with the help of clues, try to find out qualifier and qualified sentences, so that we can make pairs of qualified and qualifier sentences to eliminate the wrong choices given in the question.
    • After making pairs, start eliminating the wrong choices or options given in the question.
    • In case there is more than one choice, try to follow the sequence of sentences according to the occurrence of the events.

Hinglish 

  • विकल्पों में दिए गए गद्यांश के भागों को व्यवस्थित करते समय, हमें उनके बीच कुछ व्याकरणिक या प्रासंगिक संबंध खोजने होंगे, तो आइए जानें।

    • इसके बाद, C आएगा क्योंकि यह परीक्षा केंद्र तक पहुंचने के समय के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
    • इसके बाद D आएगा क्योंकि यह सुबह 10 बजे से पहले परीक्षा केंद्र नहीं पहुंचने के प्रभावों के बारे में बात कर रहा है।

  • The sentence 'B' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about humans crossing borders in search of jobs. Hence, B is the first sentence.
  • The phrase 'Nowhere it is more apparent' in sentence C is directly linked with 'crossing borders' mentioned in sentence B, hence C follows B.
  • The noun 'European' in sentence A is directly linked to 'Europe' mentioned in sentence C, hence A follows C.
  • The pronoun 'others' in sentence D refers back to the 'Europeans' mentioned in sentence A, hence D becomes the concluding sentence of the paragraph.

questions.questionHtml:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

Delinquency is a

P: the course of normal social life

Q: kind of normality when

R: an individual deviates from
questions.solution:
Correct option - 2

Since, the starter of the passage ends with an article a, thus it cannot be followed by an article the again. Hence, options 1 & 3 are eliminated. Now, the sentence cannot end with a preposition from. Hence, option 4 is eliminated. Thus, option 2 i.e. QRP is the correct answer.

Correct sentence - Delinquency is a kind of normality when an individual deviates from the course of normal social life.

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. He repeated the experiment, increasing the amount until he had weighed up to a thousand pounds.

B. During the spring of 1717, the iron foundries in a remote district were often visited by a thin, middle-aged man with a notebook.

C. Three cauldrons were next prepared under his directions.

D. He would weigh out two pounds of iron, have them heated till they were red-hot and then weigh them again.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "BDAC."

Key Points

  •  The paragraph is about a middle-aged man visiting iron foundries and conducting an experiment.
    • ​Thus, we will place sentence B at the beginning of the passage.
  • Further, sentence D explains what the man used to do in the iron foundaries.
  • Sentence A further explains how he repeated the experiment with increasing amounts of iron until he reached a thousand pounds.
  • Sentence C finally explains how three cauldrons were prepared under his directions.
  • Thus, it can be concluded that the correct order for the given sentences should be "BDAC."

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.
